title: Name the archive verifier's focused test in the archive-agent-notes skill

source.anchor: Run the archive verifier's focused test

task:
Problem: .agents/skills/dsh-archive-agent-notes/SKILL.md:66 instructs "Run the archive verifier's focused test, `pnpm run verify-archived-agent-notes`, `pnpm run doc-sync`, `pnpm run lint`, and `git diff --check`" without naming the test. The verifier is scripts/verify-archived-agent-notes.ts and its spec is scripts/archived-agent-notes.spec.ts — a name that does not contain `verify`, so `ls scripts | grep verify-archived` finds no spec and an agent following the skill either skips the step or runs every script spec. The same spec is what pins the `--write` behavior SKILL.md:60 relies on ("Its append-only mode first proves every existing seal still matches, then adds only the new triplet hashes"), so the skill's claim rests on a test it never names.

Required: at SKILL.md:66 name the command (`pnpm exec vitest run scripts/archived-agent-notes.spec.ts`) and link the spec with a relative link; at SKILL.md:60 link the same spec as the pin for the append-only guarantee. Leave the workflow otherwise unchanged.

Constraints: skill markdown only; do not rename the spec (a rename is a separate decision that would also move the pin); the skills tree has no Chinese counterparts; mechanical, local doc edit under the Agent Note exemption. The queue's mandatory coverage run names dsh-skill-filesystem, the package that loads skill directories; it guards that package, not this edit, and passes before and after.
